newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs to remain positive above 130.00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs to remain positive above 130.00.

text.p: September BTP futures will maintain a positive stance on Wednesday while they remain above 130.00 and will look to retrace the ground up to the recent high at 130.90, techncial analysts said.
Over the past two days the contract has traded down to a low of 129.07 on Tuesday but it recovered to close at 129.88.
"The overnight recovery above 129.75 and initial support at 130.00 keep the outlook positive," said Reynard Cheng, technical analyst at First Chicago in London.
At 0800 GMT, LIFFE September BTPs were at 130.18, up 30 basis points on the day.
Analysts said 130.00 represented a congestion area, while on daily charts 129.75 was the closing level on June 2 and just below the May 29 high at 129.78.
Cheng noted upside targets at 130.45 on the way to the June 3 high at 130.90 which marks the high for June so far.
"In the bigger picture BTPs are neutral within a broad converging range," he said.
Cheng said on six month charts this range extends from 128.90 to 131.25.
Alfredo Granata, analyst at Banca di Roma in Rome said he was optimistic on BTPs for this session.
"The contract is showing a good revaluation from yesterday's close and this upward trend could go ahead today if the U.S. market has a positive trend," he said.
Granata targeted resistance at 130.50 and then 130.65. The high this week, set on Monday, comes in between these two levels at 130.60.
To the downside Granata said there had been a lot of position taking in the 129.90 area and this would offer good support.
Below there he noted a further prop in the 129.50-45 area.
At the short end, September Eurolire futures were at 93.31, up 0.06 on the day.
